style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun through glass
motion_rule: one clear action per window, only one of them moves at a time; a body crosses the frame edge to edge every window, a moving prop alone never counts; the camera never carries a window alone; he never holds a pose; new shot size every window; his antennae whip in speech too
character: a glossy red lobster, whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small, smug realtor
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie, never still; ONE cook behind the glass, only toque and hands in frame
props: ONE fish tank; ONE toy castle on the gravel; ONE tape measure; ONE pot on a lit stove, ONE lemon; ONE pair of steel tongs; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the pot steams harder every window
environment: inside a sunlit tank, gravel floor, a bright kitchen beyond the glass

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smooth realtor patter, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ku-DA, vlo-ZHIT stress last, ne-DVI-zhi-most stress second, STU-di-yu stress first, u va-DY stress last, KUH-nyu, za-TO svoy, ne-na-DOL-ga stress third
audio.pacing: not a word before 0.9; 0.9-2.7 one breath; one pause, 2.7-3.2; 3.2-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: glass taps, claw snaps, a lid clanging, a rolling boil, a splash

timeline.a: the crab sprints the tank edge to edge, the tape measure unspooling and whipping past the lens
he kicks the castle door open and scuttles out over the gravel
he blasts off the gravel and swings up the castle wall, gravel ripping past the lens
he swings the big claw through the castle, the turret snaps off at the lens
no words, he is out of frame. The cook slams the lid down, flame flaring up the glass
timeline.c: whip sideways along the glass to the stove

timeline.a: he rams the big claw through the castle wall, it caves in, gravel blasting at the lens
he swings off the wall and rakes the glass, water sloshing
he rockets up the glass, steam boiling up the kitchen behind it
timeline.c: over him, whip up the glass

timeline.a: he vaults onto the castle roof, gravel blasting off it
he hurls himself off the roof and slams the glass at the lens
timeline.c: whip across with him to big close

timeline.a: no words. The tongs stab down and rake the whole tank, gravel exploding
the crab hauls the torn door edge to edge across the tank, gravel spraying off his legs, bow tie flapping
the tongs grip his tail and haul him out, spray blasting off
he winks as the tongs swing him over the pot, the lemon drops in first

must_appear: the crab crossing the tank at 0.0, the turret snapping off at 1.8, the crab hauling the door across at 7.9, him winking over the pot at 9.3
negative_prompt: night, low key, a still camera, a push in, a focus pull, an orbit, a static opening, a macro on a still prop, a keyhole close-up, a window where only a prop moves, anyone holding the mic, a second lobster, two actions at once, slow motion, any word after 7.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, English speech
